about: V287 error-taxonomy development cases. After V286 the misses of en_test were inspected and grouped into error TYPES (not copied). For each type these new cases were written in different words, Arabic and English, together with mild look-alikes that must NOT become emergencies. The new concept rules were built on these cases only. Author-written, development set; starter labels, not clinician-verified.
